svg.text: Razavi Ch.07 Golden Noise Design Rules (Friis Cascade + Mirror Amplification Trap)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1. Maximize gm1 of Input Device (high ID, high gm/ID) to crush both its own thermal noise 4kTγ/gm1 AND load noise ÷ gm1².

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. Minimize gm_load of Active Current-Source Loads (size loads in strong inversion with SMALL gm/ID & long L): Vn,in² ∝ gm_load / gm1²!

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3. Current-Mirror Bias Noise Trap (§7.6): A reference diode Mref mirrored by ratio K multiplies reference noise power by K²! Bypass Vbias with C_b!

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4. Flicker (1/f) Noise Rule: Input-referred 1/f noise scales as 1/(W·L·Cox); use large gate area W·L (or PMOS / Chopper) for DC-precision stages.
